althingi_lagasafn.name: Alþingi — Lagasafn
althingi_lagasafn.notes: Use the live official law page for verification. Bulk SGML snapshots are useful for discovery/indexing but can lag later amendments.

althingi_open_xml.name: Alþingi — open parliamentary XML
althingi_open_xml.notes: Official open XML. Alþingi warns that most exports lack a formal schema, may change without notice, and normally update daily.

ees_gagnagrunnur.name: EES-gagnagrunnur
ees_gagnagrunnur.publisher: Stjórnarráð Íslands / Ministry for Foreign Affairs
ees_gagnagrunnur.notes: Tracks EEA acts and Icelandic handling. Do not equate an EU act or EEA relevance with domestic Icelandic applicability. The database states that Iceland-specific information before its 2017 introduction may be incomplete.

efta_eea_lex.name: EFTA — EEA-Lex
efta_eea_lex.notes: Useful for EEA incorporation/JCD factsheets. EFTA states EEA-Lex is informational and does not replace applicable legal sources.

eur_lex.name: EUR-Lex / CELLAR
eur_lex.publisher: Publications Office of the European Union
eur_lex.notes: An EU act appearing here must never, by that fact alone, be represented as applicable Icelandic law.
